description: South Korean consumer electronics giant selling smartphones, TVs, home appliances and accessories through Samsung.com. It runs open affiliate programs an individual creator can actually join: a US program for Samsung.com/US listed on FlexOffers (apply online, free, 14-day cookie), and Samsung's own affiliate program pages (e.g. Samsung Gulf) that route sign-ups through the Optimise network and state that anyone - individual or company - can join free with a website, blog or social media profile.

evidence.summary: Samsung's own Affiliate Program page (Samsung Gulf, fetched in full) proves an open program: 'Who can become a Samsung Affiliate Program? Anyone can join the program - whether you're an individual or a company!' with a valid website, blog or social media profile; sign-up is via the Optimise platform ('Sign up on Optimise... Join now'), joining is completely free, approval typically takes about 14 business days, and affiliates 'earn commission for every confirmed sale'. No percentage rate and no earnings-cap statement are published on the page, so commission_rate is null and commission_cap is unknown.

FlexOffers' Samsung affiliate program listing (fetched in full) covers Samsung.com/US: publishers join free ('Joining the Samsung Affiliate Network is simple and free... Apply now'), get affiliate links, text links and banners, track clicks/conversions/earnings in a dashboard, and the program offers a 14-day cookie duration. The listing publishes no percentage rate, so the rate stays null (third-party directories quote conflicting figures such as 1.6%/3.2%, which are not used). No creator count is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

description: Iconic American luxury lifestyle brand. Scope note: Ralph Lauren's mainline fashion affiliate program (EMEA, on Partnerize) describes itself as invite-only, so it does NOT qualify as open. The open, joinable program verified here is the Ralph Lauren Fragrances affiliate program on FlexOffers - fragrances and grooming products, a published 10% payout on online sales, a 30-day cookie, and a public Apply Now application route for individual affiliates.

evidence.summary: FlexOffers' Ralph Lauren Fragrances Affiliate Program listing (fetched in full, page last updated September 26, 2025) states the payout verbatim: 'The payout is 10% of online sales. Gift cards are excluded.' and a 30-day cookie duration. Its 'Joining the Program' steps are a public application route: visit the program page, click 'Apply Now', fill in the application form, submit and wait for approval, then receive affiliate links, banners and promotional materials, with a dedicated affiliate management team and performance incentives. No earnings-cap statement appears, so commission_cap is unknown; no creator count is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

The mainline Ralph Lauren affiliate program (Ireland/EMEA on Partnerize, terms reproduced on this fetched listing) describes itself in the brand's own words as 'our invite only affiliate program' for 'best-in-class digital fashion publishers, top-tier influencers and partners' (commission on net sales up to 8%, 30-day cookie). Because it is invite-only, the mainline fashion program does not meet this directory's open-program rule; the entry is therefore scoped to the open Fragrances program on FlexOffers.

description: The Walt Disney Company's official merchandise store (Disney Store / shopDisney) selling toys, apparel, collectibles and home decor across Disney, Pixar, Marvel and Star Wars. Its affiliate program is open to individual publishers and creators through FlexOffers: sign up, get approved, receive banners and text links, promote on a blog, social media or family-focused website, and earn commissions on referral purchases with a 30-day cookie.

evidence.summary: FlexOffers' Disney Store (shopDisney) affiliate program listing (fetched in full) proves an open program: 'Join the Disney Store affiliate program and earn commissions', with a five-step public route - Sign Up (apply on the program page), Get Approved, Access Marketing Assets (banners, text links, promotional creatives), Promote Products on a blog, social media or family-focused website, Earn Commissions - and a stated 30-day cookie duration. The page explicitly calls the program 'perfect for content creators, influencers, and Disney fan sites'. It publishes no percentage rate, so commission_rate is null (directories report around 2% for shopDisney, not stated on the network listing itself). No earnings-cap statement and no creator count appear, so commission_cap and creator_saturation are unknown.
